welcome.title: Welcome to VoIP Admin!
welcome.description: This quick tour will help you get started with the main features of the admin panel.

env-selector.title: Select Your Environment
env-selector.description: Choose which customer and environment you want to manage. All data is scoped to your selection.

users-menu.title: Manage Users
users-menu.description: Create user accounts, set permissions with ACLs, and manage devices for phone calls.

dids-menu.title: Manage Routes
dids-menu.description: Configure phone numbers (Routes) and set up call routing to IVRs, queues, or devices.

subscriptions-menu.title: Subscriptions & Billing
subscriptions-menu.description: Manage billing subscriptions, assign tariffs, and track subscription balances.

tour-complete.title: You're Ready!
tour-complete.description: You can restart this tour anytime from the Help menu. Enjoy using VoIP Admin!

did-list.title: Route List
did-list.description: This table shows all your Routes. Use the filters on the left to narrow down the list.

did-create.title: Create New Route
did-create.description: Click here to add a new phone number to your system.

did-bridge.title: Bridge Types
did-bridge.description: Bridge type determines where calls go: IVR for menus, Queue for call centers, Device for direct lines.

devzone-overview.title: One live Developer Zone
devzone-overview.description: Search the current OpenAPI contract, connect an AI agent, or follow the human quickstart without leaving Nimbus.

devzone-connect-mcp.title: Connect through MCP
devzone-connect-mcp.description: Copy this endpoint into an MCP-capable agent, with a token of its own. Its tools see only that account's customer.

devzone-navigation.title: Explore by task
devzone-navigation.description: Use the quickstart for a first request, API Reference for endpoints grouped in the left rail, and Automation readiness for agent safety guidance.

help-button.title: Need Help?
help-button.description: Click the help icon on any screen to open the documentation for that feature.

refresh-button.title: Refresh Data
refresh-button.description: Click to reload the latest data from the server.
